scope: Reproduce the per-mutation OLS count summary using the production centered-moment kernel. This does not validate the public pooled DRI/ICI aggregation; no synthetic genotype graph is constructed.
preprocessing: eLife 76491 Supplementary file 1 BYxRM_s/BYxRM_x joined by Sample, Type=Experiment in data_by_mutation. Keep each mutation with >=50 finite paired backgrounds. Equal weights; s is the author per-generation selection coefficient, X the supplied background fitness. Use both signs of s without edge-sign filtering; OLS with intercept, two-sided t-test with n-2 degrees of freedom, uncorrected p<0.05. Beneficial/deleterious classification uses sign of mean s. No imputation, uncertainty weighting, FDR, RNG, or transformation.
